title: 第二十八章  出手
content_zh:
瞬间双方就已经发动了进攻的信号，只见陈木即使是在面对对面的人的时候也毫不手软，虽然对方在人数上是它的十几倍二十几倍，但这一点问题都解决不了，陈木正在用最快的速度一一解决这些人。

    之间在昏暗的地下车库里面，因为灯光的映照，就连人的影子都有些朦朦胧胧，陈木却能够分毫不差的在这样昏暗的环境之中抓住这些人的要害，然后以毙命绝对是专业的训练有素的手法。

    随着陈木的动作越来越快，倒在地上的人也越来越多，哀嚎声此起彼伏的在整个地下车库里面一直回荡着。

    苏林依和孙依诗坐在车里面并不知道外面到底发生了什么，但是听着外面各种像是中午落地一样的声音还是能够分辨得出大概有多少人。

    “哇哇哇哇哇哇，第十一个了！”孙依诗听着外面的动静，整个人不受控制的尖叫起来，看上去就像是见到了自家偶像站在自己面前的小迷妹一样，简直就是不能够比现在更激动的样子了。

    “小诗，你要淡定，陈木之前的样子你不是早就已经见过了吗？不用这么激动吧？”苏林依看着在车子里面依旧是手舞足蹈的孙依诗，微笑着说道，但是自己并没有不理会外面的情况，而是和孙依诗一样听着外面的动静然后在心里默默地数着。

    陈木觉得眼前这些人完全就是天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你自来投的典型写照，下手丝毫不留情，浑身都撒发着极其凌厉的气场，后面的小喽啰看着前面的人已经跪了一批又一批，都有些不可置信，甚至已经不敢再继续上前了。

    陈木在达到了第十五个之后，周围只剩下十几个人围着了，看样子刚刚来的人已经被陈木给清除了一半。

    “你们一起上吧，别浪费我时间。”陈木看了看手上的表，发现要送苏林依她们回去的时间已经被这件事情给耽误了，于是十分的不耐烦，堪则这些蝼蚁就更加生气，但面上依旧是冷冷的面瘫脸，就连一丝一毫的表情都没有显现出来。

    一边站着观望的人此时已经是进退两难，他们认为自己还算是有些身手，三十人对付一个毛头小子实在是绰绰有余，甚至都可以说是大材小用了，结果没想到才刚刚和这个毛头小子见面五分钟不到，就已经被撂倒了一般。

    看来那个王公子说的还真没错。

    “兄弟们，拼了包围他往死里打！”为首的那个蒙面人冲了出来，二话不说就打算一棒子打到陈木身上，但是陈木怎么可能会被人打到？很轻松的一个转身就躲过了这次的袭击，继而一个回旋踢，正中那个人的脖子，直接就把人踢到了地上爬都爬不起来。

    眼见着蒙面人的老大倒下了，其余的人也不管不顾的疯狂冲了上来，手中还有闪亮的长刀，陈木根本就没有把这些放在眼里，几个起跳旋身，脚下攻击片刻不停，基本上都是一脚一个，有时候甚至还能够一脚两个，不到三分钟就已经速战速决了，十分钟左右，地上的人全都是哀嚎阵阵，根本就没有从地上爬起来的能力了。
content_en:
In an instant, the two sides had launched an attack signal, and Chen Mu showed no mercy even when facing the people on the opposite side. Although the opponent was more than ten or twenty times more numerous than him, this problem could not be solved at all. Chen Mu was using the fastest speed to deal with these people one by one.

    In the dark underground garage, even the shadows of people were a little hazy due to the reflection of the lights. However, Chen Mu was able to accurately grasp the vital points of these people in such a dim environment, and then kill them with absolutely professional and well-trained techniques.

    As Chen Mu moved faster and faster, more and more people fell to the ground, and wailing sounds echoed throughout the underground garage.

    Su Linyi and Sun Yishi were sitting in the car and didn't know what was going on outside, but they could still tell how many people there were by listening to the various sounds outside that sounded like falling to the ground at noon.

    "Wow wow wow wow wow, it's the eleventh one!" Sun Yishi screamed uncontrollably as she listened to the movement outside. She looked like a little fan girl who saw her idol standing in front of her. She couldn't be more excited than she was now.

    "Xiao Shi, you have to calm down. Haven't you seen Chen Mu's appearance before? Don't be so excited, right?" Su Linyi looked at Sun Yi Shi who was still dancing in the car and said with a smile. However, she did not ignore the situation outside. Instead, like Sun Yi Shi, she listened to the movements outside and counted silently in her heart.

    Chen Mu felt that these people in front of him were a typical portrayal of those who refused to take the road to heaven and threw themselves into hell without any mercy. They showed no mercy and exuded an extremely fierce aura. The minions in the back looked at the people in front of them who had knelt down one after another. They were all a little unbelievable and did not even dare to move forward anymore.

    After Chen Mu reached the fifteenth place, there were only a dozen people left around him. It seemed that half of the people who had just arrived had been eliminated by Chen Mu.

    "Come on together, don't waste my time." Chen Mu looked at the watch in his hand and found that the time to send Su Linyi and the others back had been delayed by this matter, so he became very impatient, which made these ants even more angry, but his face was still cold and paralyzed, without even a trace of expression showing.

    The people standing and watching were in a dilemma at this time. They thought that they had some skills. Thirty people were more than enough to deal with a young boy. They could even be said to be overqualified and overqualified. However, they did not expect that within five minutes of meeting this young boy, he had already been knocked down.

    It seems that the prince is really right.

    "Brothers, surround him with all your strength and beat him to death!" The masked man at the head rushed out and planned to hit Chen Mu with a stick without saying a word, but how could Chen Mu be hit? He easily dodged the attack with a turn, and then a roundhouse kick, hitting the man in the neck, knocking him to the ground and making him unable to get up.

    Seeing that the boss of the masked man fell, the rest of them rushed up madly without caring, with shining long knives in their hands. Chen Mu didn't pay attention to these at all. He jumped up and spun around, and attacked without stopping for a moment, basically one kick at a time, and sometimes even two at a time. In less than three minutes, the battle was over quickly. In about ten minutes, everyone on the ground was wailing, and they had no ability to get up from the ground.
